directionSent: deep, resonant, booming, noble and ancient
heardByWhisper: The characters hear a loud flapping noise, and then a warm rush of air hits their faces.  Standing before you now is a great silver dragon. He says,  You are wise to seek my counsel, and I can help you.  Far to the east there is a large kobold complex. There is a silver bottle of great power there that  will help you on your quest. Retrieve that bottle, then return, and I will send you on another quest.  After speaking, the dragon flies through an opening in the ceiling of the cave.  You exit the cave to continue your quest.
